source.name: Cyclingnews — Bahrain Victorious announce 2026 bike sponsor (Tom Wieckowski)
source.quote: Bahrain Victorious have partnered with Bianchi as the official bike supplier for the 2026 racing season and beyond

summary: 2026 UCI WorldTeam home kit by Alé. Front: Bahrain EDB, Mumtalakat, Bapco Energies; back: Beyon, NBB, Al Salam Bank, Alba; sleeves/side: OMNIYAT; bike supplier Bianchi. The team's partners page lists further technical and regional suppliers (Rudy Project, Vision, Continental, Valour, Eurospin, Foulath and others) not itemised here.
